packageRules.description: DOCSight tags (v2026-08-07.1) aren't semver -- without an explicit versioning scheme, Renovate's default docker versioning would silently ignore or missort them and never propose updates. Applies to both the Dockerfile manager and the build.yaml custom manager.
prBodyNotes: **Merging this PR is all that's needed:** the `auto-release.yml` workflow then bumps `docsight/config.yaml`'s version to `<new-tag>-addon.1`, prepends a CHANGELOG entry, creates the GitHub Release, and dispatches the image build automatically. One thing to still check by hand: upstream's `app/drivers/__init__.py` for newly registered modem drivers -- the `modem_type` list in `docsight/config.yaml`'s schema is hardcoded and needs new drivers added manually.
